hints.title: Partial Arity Accumulation
hints.text: Transforming a multi-parameter function into a sequence of unary or partial invocations accumulates incoming arguments until the formal parameter count is reached.

hints.title: Comparing Arity Against Target Length
hints.text: Inspect the length property of the original target function. If the collected arguments count meets or exceeds arity, invoke the original function; otherwise, return a new closure collecting subsequent arguments.

hints.title: Recursive Currying Blueprint
hints.text: Return curried function that gathers (...args). If args.length >= fn.length, return fn(...args). Else return (...nextArgs) => curried(...args, ...nextArgs).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each invocation performs constant-time argument concatenation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Fixed single-argument currying fails when callers pass multiple arguments in a single intermediate call.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Closures retain collected arguments until the final evaluation executes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Inspecting fn.length correctly and allowing variable argument counts per intermediate step.

solutions.approach: Recursive Arity Accumulation with Variadic Closures
